title: Padded second-component decoder
statement: For bit strings $s$ and $v$, first take the second component of the pair parse of $s$, using the empty string if parsing fails. Apply the padded decoder to that string and $v$: it returns the prefix before the last $1$ in $v$ if that prefix has the same length as the first string, and otherwise returns the first string; if there is no $1$ in $v$, it returns the first string.
